cves.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
cves.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain super-admin privileges via crafted requests to Node.js websocket module.
cves.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cves.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
cves.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to gain super-admin privileges via crafted CSF proxy requests.
cves.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
